prBodyNotes: **Manual finish before merge** (HelmForge gates - see CONTRIBUTING.md and standards-check.yml GR-079). (1) The chart `version` is auto-derived from the Conventional Commit scope: do NOT edit it by hand - land this as `fix(<chart>)` or `feat(<chart>)` so the release tooling bumps the right chart. (2) Update `appVersion` in `Chart.yaml` when the application image tag changes. (3) Add an `artifacthub.io/changes` entry in `Chart.yaml`. (4) For subchart dependency bumps run `helm dependency build charts/<chart>` so `Chart.lock` is committed. (5) Validate with `./test.sh <chart>` and, before merge, `./test.sh <chart> --runtime` on the local `k3d-helmforge-tests-wsl` context (mandatory per CONTRIBUTING.md). (6) Satisfy the site-sync and release rules.

packageRules.description: Container image tags in chart values.yaml (image / controller.image / server.image / app.image / ...). One PR per image; never automerge - each needs a Chart.yaml version bump + artifacthub changelog.
Chart.yaml cohesion: update appVersion alongside the image tag when the same chart is touched.
HelmForge OCI subchart dependencies (oci://ghcr.io/helmforgedev/helm). Grouped into one PR; never automerge.
GitHub Actions pins in .github/workflows. Grouped, ci-labelled to match the existing Dependabot convention.
Digest-only updates are never automerged (charts pin tags, not digests).
Major bumps always need manual review + k3d validation.
Pilot scope (maintainer spec): default-disable Renovate for every chart dependency manager - a limited, representative set starts enabled.

Pilot scope: re-enable only the representative charts (stalwart: Gateway API + ExternalSecret + apply-job; bulwark-mail: JMAP webmail image; ib-gateway: image-only Interactive Brokers Gateway; gitea: ExternalSecret-heavy; questdb, openhuman, hermes-agent, openclaw: digest-pinned images; atuin, attic: image-only). Remove the last two pilot rules to widen coverage after parity.
